15:    cents are handed out one each, to the parties with the largest fractional remainder.

python3 - <<'PY'
from money import allocate
from fractions import Fraction
from decimal import Decimal

assert allocate(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
assert allocate(100, [1, 2]) == [33, 67]
assert allocate(7, [0.1, 0.2, 0.7]) == [1, 1, 5]
assert allocate(0, [3, 5]) == [0, 0]
assert allocate(-5, [1, 1]) == [-3, -2]

# exact arithmetic ties: float vs exact
assert allocate(3, [0.1, 0.2]) == [1, 2]
assert allocate(1, [0.5, 0.5]) == [1, 0]  # equal weights -> lower index
assert allocate(1, [1, 2]) == [0, 1]      # larger weight wins tie in remainder
assert allocate(2, [1, 1, 1]) == [1, 1, 0]
assert allocate(1, [0, 1, 1]) == [0, 1, 0]
assert allocate(5, [0, 1]) == [0, 5]
assert allocate(5, [Fraction(1,3), Fraction(2,3)]) == [2, 3]
assert allocate(10, [Decimal('0.1'), Decimal('0.2'), Decimal('0.7')]) == [1, 2, 7]
assert allocate(-7, [0.1, 0.2, 0.7]) == [-1, -1, -5]
assert sum(allocate(1234567, [3, 5, 7, 11])) == 1234567

# not modified
w = [1, 2, 3]
allocate(4, w)
assert w == [1, 2, 3]

# errors
def fails(fn, exc=ValueError):
    try:
        fn()
    except exc:
        return
    raise AssertionError('did not fail')

fails(lambda: allocate(1, []))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [-1]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [0, 0]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [float('nan')]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [float('inf')]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [float('-inf')]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [Decimal('NaN')]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1, [Decimal('Infinity')]))
fails(lambda: allocate(True, [1]))
fails(lambda: allocate(1.0, [1]))
fails(lambda: allocate('1', [1]))

print('all checks passed')
PY
